posts.title: Grim week wipes billions from Australian share market
posts.description: Australian shares have had their worst calendar week since early 2020 as miners and tech stocks crumbled under the weight of ongoing artificial intelligence doubts.

posts.title: Private contractor Ertech doubles profit
posts.description: Engineering and construction contractor Ertech Holdings has doubled its profit, aided by a substantial increase in the value of its investment in ASX-listed contractor Duratec.

posts.title: Construction begins on Swanbourne park project
posts.description: Andrew and Nicola Forrest's Minderoo Foundation has donated $2 million towards the parkland development neighbouring the Sandcastles Children's Hospice, opened last month.
